violations.text: -Raw animal foods such as raw chicken over cooked pork and raw shelled eggs over broccoli were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. -Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination (raw chicken over raw pork). Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

Trays of egg rolls, rice, fried chicken, and cooked pork were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

Vitamins and medications were observed stored above prep unit. These items are to be placed in a location to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens and single service items. Items were replaced during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

Chicken breasts and cuts of whole beef were observed in the chest freezer in direct contact with another and interior walls and accumulated frost inside chest freezer. PIC informed to cease practice. Items were in process of being removed during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026
Foods were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

Duct tape is used to hold together chest freezer lids. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -walk-in cooler shelving and mats -walk-in cooler fan guards -behind and around prep units and tables -inside and outside of chest freezers New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
Allergen advisory statement is not present on menus or order point. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2025
All handwashing sinks are lacking notification signage. State handout provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025

Raw animal foods such as eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as celery in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025

Various prepared foods in the walk-in cooler were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025

The cutting boards are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 02/24/2025

Chest freezer located in office was observed in poor repair (gaskets in poor repair and insulation of lid exposed). Equipment also observed with an accumulation of ice and black residue. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2025

Several areas in the kitchen (including walls, floors and surrounding areas near equipment) have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 02/24/2025

Floor tiles in the kitchen area were not in proper adjustment and/or in good repair (observed detached and/or cracked). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2025
